text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finished the fierce race, Eishin 
Flash finds herself perplexed by her 
inability to suppress her surging 
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, accepting even those emotions as 
"righteousness," she stoked her fighting 
spirit for the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, watching those following behind 
overcome their "walls" and grow, Fuji 
Kiseki smiled with deep satisfaction—
